bodyBrief: Create original game sprite artwork, transparent PNG, wide 4-column by 2-row grid, eight distinct views of ONE identical fictional year-2994 restored deep plum/pale grey boxy 1993 European 240 SE estate wagon, inspired by Volvo 240 UK B200F 2.0 manual. NO logos badges lettering watermarks. Long square five-door estate, tall greenhouse, rectangular headlights and vertical rectangular tail lamps, narrow chrome belt trim, black rubber bumpers, slight salvaged repair panels. NOT racing car. EXACT views top row: straight FRONT, front three-quarter nose pointing RIGHT, SIDE nose RIGHT, rear three-quarter nose RIGHT. Bottom: straight REAR, rear three-quarter nose LEFT, SIDE nose LEFT, front three-quarter nose LEFT. Each view separate generous transparent gutters, full vehicle no crop. Clean hand-painted realistic retro game illustration, consistent proportions. Crucial: NO TIRES OR WHEELS; all wheel openings transparent empty semicircular cutouts for runtime wheels. Transparent everywhere outside body; no ground shadows or scenery. Four columns two rows. VERY IMPORTANT pack SMALLER vehicles: each car no more than 340 pixels wide on an approximately 1800-pixel wide canvas. Leave at least 60 pixels FULLY TRANSPARENT BETWEEN every adjacent car. Outer border at least40 pixels. No overlap no touching. All eight views must fit completely. Make a clean sprite sheet, not a montage.
